inputs.doc: HEADPUB e043b-xl144-nolonhold-s1 · PUBLISHES the xl144 stage-2 head that #426 (E-043b-SEED1) trained for the full 200,000 steps at SEED 1 on the EXISTING frozen f3_anchor41M codec with the stage-2 pool opened to ALL 481 longitude columns (--train-lon-hold none, recipe xl144-nolonhold) · params 211.353M head (+ 40.693M frozen codec) · stage headpub (NOTHING trains; strips /opt/earth-cache/ckpt/temporal.pt to weights-only and uploads head-weights-e043b-xl144-nolonhold-s1.pt) · data family3_na025 (C 39, T 516, sha256 adcbe700fb6e) · arch codec 576x10, 8 heads, d_dec 768, d_z 64, patch 3; head 1024x16, K 24, stencil 145, ring spiral:111,4444,0.71,0.5 · steps x batch 200,000 x 256 stage-2 (= the checkpoint's own recorded count; this job trains zero steps) · resume !run-62,run-63 (f3_anchor41M, frozen). WHY NOW, AND WHY THIS IS URGENT RATHER THAN ROUTINE: #426 finished 200,000 steps at 16:59:11Z with stage2_result z_mse_model 0.04376167 / z_mse_persistence 3.12627649 = ratio 0.013998, against #414's seed-0 0.01392 — the training-half anomaly reproduces at n=2. But the weights exist in EXACTLY ONE PLACE. scripts/snapshot_head.sh ran 29 times across #426, from 02:19:36Z to 16:28:42Z, and EVERY ONE of them failed the upload with curl exit 22 / HTTP 422 — the ~2 GiB release-asset cap against a ~2.4 GB optimiser-carrying checkpoint — each time emitting the warning 'the head is only on this box'. So 15 h 46 min of RTX 4090 is single-copy on gpu-box-31479844 (vast 47724559), one host eviction from gone, which is what #396 taught. A published weights-only asset (~845 MB, well under the cap) is both the backup and the only form a sroll can name. SOURCE PINNED TO @temporal DELIBERATELY, for the reason #412 recorded: a box's orphan-temporal-latest.pt can be a stale leftover, and publishing that leftover is what #377/#378/#381/#382 did. VOID CONDITION, and it is a single field: the job's torch.load line must print step=200000 d_model=1024 layers=16 stencil=145 SEED=1 znoise=0.0 and params=211.4M, and the checkpoint args must carry train_lon_hold none. seed=1 is the ONLY printed field that distinguishes this head from #414's seed-0 head, which shares every other one; if it prints seed=0 the file is #414-era, the asset is the wrong file, and it must NOT be evaluated. The published asset is then the input to the E-043b-SEED1 sroll, whose corridor _trainlon AUC against #422's 0.93933 is the seed pair §3b requires before any level from this configuration may be quoted.
